scenario: Two friends hanging out, one of them just got a new sports car and is excited to show it off.
learner_goal: Drive the sports car and show off to friend (<extra_info>Extra information: you are very excited about your new car and can't wait for your friend to see it.</extra_info>)
partner_goal: You want to drive the new sports car but also respect your friend's feelings (<extra_info>Extra information: you are a car enthusiast and have been dreaming to drive a sports car, but you also don't want to make your friend feel uncomfortable</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: Lena! Come check out my new car — I finally got the sports car I told you about. Want to take a quick spin? I can't wait to show you the interior and hear what you think of the engine.

transcript.speaker: Lena Goodwin
transcript.content: Oh wow — congrats, Naomi! It looks amazing. I’d love to see the interior... and, if you’re comfortable with it, could I take it for a very quick spin? I’m a bit of a car nerd, but I don’t want to make you uncomfortable — I can ride along or you can drive if you’d prefer.

transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: Perfect — hop in! I’ll drive first so you can hear the engine and see the interior up close, then if you want we can swap for a quick lap. Seatbelts on?

transcript.speaker: Lena Goodwin
transcript.content: Seatbelts on — thanks, Naomi! I’ll hop in shotgun and listen to the engine and take in the interior. If you’re comfortable, I’d love to swap for a quick lap after you’ve had a moment with it.

transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: Awesome — thanks! I’ll start it up so you can hear the engine. Ready? I’ll do a quick lap around the block, then we can swap if you want — feel free to adjust the seat and mirrors.

transcript.speaker: Lena Goodwin
transcript.content: Go for it! I’ll enjoy the first lap — the engine already sounds incredible. When you pull back up, give me the nod and I’ll quickly adjust seat and mirrors and take a careful, short lap. No pressure at all if you’d rather keep driving.

transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: Alright — starting her up. Listen to that first rev! I’ll do a quick lap around the block; give me a thumbs-up when you’re ready to swap seats.

transcript.speaker: Lena Goodwin
transcript.content: [non-verbal communication] Gives a big thumbs-up and a grin, mouthing 'ready.'

transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: Sweet — pulling out now. I’ll take it easy on the first lap; when we get back give me a thumbs-up and I’ll stop so you can switch in.

transcript.speaker: Lena Goodwin
transcript.content: [non-verbal communication] Gives another enthusiastic thumbs-up, then points to the passenger seat and makes a quick seat-adjusting gesture with a reassuring grin.

transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: Awesome — thanks! I’ll keep it mellow on this lap. When I pull up by the curb at the café I’ll give you a thumbs so you can hop in and tweak the seat/mirrors — can’t wait to hear what you think behind the wheel.

transcript.speaker: Lena Goodwin
transcript.content: Perfect — I’ll be ready by the curb. Thanks for offering the swap; I’ll just do a short, careful lap and be gentle. No pressure at all if you’d rather keep driving.

transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: Great — pulling up to the curb now. I’ll give you the thumbs when it’s safe; I can point out any controls you want before you take the wheel.

transcript.speaker: Lena Goodwin
transcript.content: Thanks, Naomi — I’ll be ready. Could you quickly point out the ignition, gear selector, mirrors and any sport-mode or paddle-shift quirks before I take over? I’ll do one short, careful lap and be super gentle, promise.

transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: Quick rundown: ignition is the push-start button to the right of the wheel — foot on the brake to start. Gear selector is on the center console (D for drive, pull the little switch/lever or flip to S for sport depending on the model), and there are paddle shifters behind the wheel if you want manual shifts. Mirrors and seat adjustments are on the driver's door panel; the sport-mode button is near the shifter — I’ll point to each one and show the paddles when I stop. Give me a thumbs when you’re ready and I’ll pull over so you can swap in.

transcript.speaker: Lena Goodwin
transcript.content: Sounds good — thanks for the rundown. I’ll watch you point things out at the curb; give me the thumbs when you’ve stopped and I’ll hop in and adjust seat/mirrors. I’ll keep it short and gentle.

transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: [non-verbal communication] Pulls safely to the curb, gives a clear thumbs-up, then points to the push-start button, the gear selector/sport-mode, the mirrors/seat controls, and the paddle shifters to show where they are.

transcript.speaker: Lena Goodwin
transcript.content: Thanks, Naomi — I’m ready. I’ll quickly adjust the seat and mirrors, start it, and do one short, careful lap in normal mode unless you want me to try sport. I’ll be super gentle — just give me the signal if you want the wheel back.

transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: Perfect — hop in, I’ll get out so you can slide over. Keep it in Normal for the short lap and be gentle with the throttle; when you pull back, give me a wave and I’ll take it back for one more lap in Sport. Have fun — can’t wait to hear what you think!

transcript.speaker: Lena Goodwin
transcript.content: Thanks, Naomi — sliding over now. I’ll keep it in Normal and be gentle on the throttle; I’ll give you a wave when I pull back up. If there’s anything else you want me to check before I go, tell me now — otherwise, see you in a minute!

scenario_title: One-way exhibition of a new flashy possession to a friend, imbalance of enthusiasm and ownership | skills from the proud owner balancing enthusiastic display with preserving a friend's comfort
